searchSummary: The initial twelve-candidate C-first slate was completed before comparison, then expanded to under-exercised source owners across game, room-generation, prayer, combat, and item-use behaviors. Nine source-distinct first mismatches and five distinct full-match controls remain. Source/overlap review excludes generic place_lregion/LR_BRANCH and the v32 pool-water duplicate. The remaining searches produced a matching temple, a matching peaceful shopkeeper, two materially different hostile-shopkeeper setup failures, and an infeasible monster-disease setup. The queue is empty; the coordinator directed a smaller batch to restore worker capacity. All 780 v46 case-file hashes are included in the preserved attempt inventory.
decision: Coordinator-directed smaller v46 batch: the refreshed admitted queue is empty and A/B/C have no selectable work. Nine source-distinct mismatches restore independent work. After planning well over twelve candidates, materially different replacements produced matching controls, duplicate first-mismatch owners, or concrete setup deferrals: depth-nine temple generation matched; peaceful natural shopkeeper taming matched; the hostile shopkeeper died before its branch after two materially different setup routes; monster-disease setup remained infeasible. Preserve recordings and hashes; do not invent cases.
